body.condition: For every \((j,k)\in\vec E\), \(0<\ell_{jk}\le u_{jk}\) and there exists \(\rho_{jk}(P)\in[\ell_{jk},u_{jk}]\) such that \(B_j(P)=\rho_{jk}(P)B_k(P)\).

novel.justification: Positive proportional biases with pair-specific intervals that need not contain one accommodate calibrated settings whose relative confounding direction is common but whose magnitudes are known to be ordered, as when administrative sites share an omitted risk index and external validation bounds one site's loading above another's.
